globalRules: A name match is never sufficient for canonical entity promotion.
Prefer stable source identifiers such as Wikidata and SeshatID when present.
A source entity may map to one canonical entity only after review; ambiguous matches remain unresolved.
Entity identity does not imply historical ownership, control, or province geometry.
No 1300 geometry may be copied, relabelled, or promoted into the 1326 dataset.
Candidate match confidence records identity evidence only and must not be interpreted as geometry confidence.
